<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def blocks(fr):
    out={}
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in 'RbN' and n['pixels']==16:
            b=n['boundary']; r0=min(p[0] for p in b)
            if r0<50: out[n['color']]=(r0,min(p[1] for p in b),max(p[0] for p in b),max(p[1] for p in b))
    return out
def ptop(fr):
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='M' and n['pixels']==18:
            return min(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])
    return None
def beam(fr):
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='w':
            r0=min(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])
            if 12<r0<42: return r0
    return None
print('before:', 'ptop',ptop(current_frame),'beam',beam(current_frame),blocks(current_frame))
action(['UP'])
print('after UP:', 'ptop',ptop(current_frame),'beam',beam(current_frame),blocks(current_frame))

</parameter>
